Title: KENNEDY SPACE CENTER, FLA. -  STS-82 Payload Commander Mark C. Lee prepares to step down from the T-38 jet he flew from an air field serving the astronauts' home base at Johnson Space Center, Houston, Texas, to KSC's Shuttle Landing Facility.  Lee and the other six members of the STS-82 crew will spend the last few days before launch at KSC.  STS-82 is scheduled for liftoff on Feb. 11 during a 65-minute launch window that opens at 3:56 a.m. EST.  The 10-day flight aboard the Space Shuttle Discovery will be the second Hubble Space Telescope (HST) servicing mission.
CreditLine: NASA Image and Video Library (public domain)
